detailed_descriptions.en: "Vino la Catrina a la tribu, dispuesta a llevarse a la gente; el jefe le enseñó la lista de chamba… y ahora pica piedra, muy obediente." — La Catrina came to the tribe, ready to take everyone away. The chief showed her the work roster… and now she's breaking rocks, very obediently. Welcome to the fiesta of Bone Bash – yes, you're dead, but that's not the end. You and your tribesmen have simply taken on a far more entertaining form! Turn your tribe into an endless Day of the Dead fiesta with this themed pack! Giant painted skulls, fields of marigolds, flickering altar candles, and colorful papel picado banners can all find a home in your territory. Your tribesmen will keep chopping wood, forging metal, and patrolling as walking skeletons. Dead? Still gotta work! This theme pack includes: 1 new Mask appearance – [Joyous Return] The reveler who leads the dead in dance, opening the flower-strewn gate to the Land of the Dead! 4 Tribesman Skins, 2 Character Accessories, 1 Mount Skin Vibrant skeleton looks for the dearly departed – if you're going to die, die in style! 43 Placeables, 56 Building Pieces A brand-new [Carved Stone] Aztec tribal building set, plus everything you need to turn your tribe into a fully operational Bone Factory ! All items are cosmetic and share the same stats as existing items of the same tier. No gameplay advantage is granted.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
"Vino la Catrina a la tribu, dispuesta a llevarse a la gente; el jefe le enseñó la lista de chamba… y ahora pica piedra, muy obediente."
— La Catrina came to the tribe, ready to take everyone away. The chief showed her the work roster… and now she's breaking rocks, very obediently.

Welcome to the fiesta of Bone Bash – yes, you're dead, but that's not the end. You and your tribesmen have simply taken on a far more entertaining form!

Turn your tribe into an endless Day of the Dead fiesta with this themed pack! Giant painted skulls, fields of marigolds, flickering altar candles, and colorful papel picado banners can all find a home in your territory. Your tribesmen will keep chopping wood, forging metal, and patrolling as walking skeletons. Dead? Still gotta work!

This theme pack includes:

  • 1 new Mask appearance – [Joyous Return]
    The reveler who leads the dead in dance, opening the flower-strewn gate to the Land of the Dead!

  • 4 Tribesman Skins, 2 Character Accessories, 1 Mount Skin
    Vibrant skeleton looks for the dearly departed – if you're going to die, die in style!

  • 43 Placeables, 56 Building Pieces
    A brand-new [Carved Stone] Aztec tribal building set, plus everything you need to turn your tribe into a fully operational Bone Factory!

All items are cosmetic and share the same stats as existing items of the same tier. No gameplay advantage is granted.
